_comment: Reviewed no-growth ceilings for the god functions (roadmap 1.1.x item 16.4; score card 2026-08-27 Maintainability 'Upgrade to C+', of which this file is HALF — the other half is one merged extraction, which is 1.1.2 item 7). `lines` is the AST span (end_lineno - lineno + 1, decorators excluded) measured at tag v1.1.0. tests/unit/test_function_length_baseline.py (fast suite) fails when a function GROWS past its ceiling AND when it SHRINKS below it — shrinkage must tighten the ceiling in the same commit so the baseline never overstates the debt. There is no writer: edit this file by hand with the measured value. It is NOT package data (unlike architecture_baseline.json, which maxim --audit-architecture reads at runtime): only the test reads it, so shipping it in the wheel would be a packaging requirement nothing consumes. Note the strict equality: a pure reformat that shortens a function reddens the fast suite with a 'it shrank' message — deliberate, so a ceiling can never quietly overstate the debt. HISTORY: run_agentic_loop tightened 3546 -> 3512 on 2026-08-30 (1.1.2 Cluster B, the first extraction) when sections 7 (CALL STEP CALLBACK) and 8.5 (BIO-SYSTEM PER-TICK MAINTENANCE) moved to the module-level _loop_step_callback / _loop_bio_tick_maintenance in agent_loop.py; mechanical move, section order preserved.
